description: This file defines a Playwright component class 'Menu' for automating interactions with Ant Design dropdown menus, including methods for opening submenus via hover, keyboard, or dispatchEvent, and selecting submenu items.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: A component class for interacting with Ant Design dropdown menus in automated tests, supporting hover, keyboard, and event dispatch methods to open submenus and select items.

methods.name: selectSubmenuItem
methods.description: Attempts to open a submenu and select an item using hover, keyboard, or dispatchEvent fallback methods.

methods.name: openSubmenuWithHover
methods.description: Uses Playwright's hover to open a submenu and waits for the popup to become visible.

methods.name: openSubmenuWithKeyboard
methods.description: Uses keyboard arrow navigation to open a submenu and waits for the popup.

methods.name: openSubmenuWithDispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches mouseover and mouseenter events to open a submenu and waits for the popup.

methods.name: getSubmenuTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the locator for a submenu title element containing specified text.
